**brief:** a prompt the relevance model reads as off topic is no longer silenced when one structural co-file holds half or more of its informative keywords (`shared ≥ 2`, `shared*2 ≥ informative`, `structural_files > 0`) — the same footing a walkthrough already needed. On the public bench (`eval/brief-bench`, 56 questions) it turns 8 closed false negatives into open briefs, and kind-admitted prompts (`kind: flow`, `kind: overview`) that coverage now opens render their answered evidence instead of an empty pack.
